source_identity: Operator-supplied EpochPlanet-0.2.3-source. Retained owners preserve supplied hashes; explicitly adapted world, terrain and simulation owners record original_sha256 and local_changes separately.

src/core/world.cpp.local_changes: Optional validated WorldConfig scales body radii, terrain amplitudes, atmosphere and orbital distances together, preserving default constructor output and original gravity/orbit periods. Geography-scale sampling retains proportional color and normal thresholds.

src/core/terrain.cpp.local_changes: One shared planner offers explicit selected-body planning with existing screen-error/balance-closure priority; legacy all-world order/signature are preserved. Optional world size scales geometric normal stencils, minimum skirts and geographic vegetation eligibility without adding a second mesher. An additive explicit ocean-surface planner overload scores the closest rendered ground or sea surface only for admitted wet requests; original terrain-only overloads, mesh generation, gravity and landing samples remain unchanged. Optional validated TerrainView adds a conservative full-height patch envelope and an explicit in-view queue tier while retaining complete balanced coarse coverage and unchanged no-view ordering; it is detail priority, not renderer occlusion. A bounded double-precision procedural camera-ray march prioritizes its actual visible-surface hit, with a derived height-field Lipschitz bound, 5cm target tolerance, a bounded 16384-step budget for grazing rays, and conservative no-hit/exhaustion fallback. The ray-hit ancestry receives at most two extra detail levels under the same maximum level, balanced coverage and fixed leaf budget. This is refinement only, not a collision query. An optional camera-up field enables forward, exactly 45-degree camera-down with roll, and radial-nadir refinement rays near the visible ground or sea surface. Each ray retains its 16384-step limit (49152 aggregate per selected body). Only actual hit ancestry may bypass view-cone exclusion. A cubic smooth altitude weight trades the three-hit attention for a broad central region of quarter vertical-FOV radius with a smooth outer taper; the queue combines continuous attention and bounded monotonic screen-error priority, retaining the existing at-most-two-level screen-error bias. Near bound is clamp(radius*0.002,25m,5000m); far is max(near*4,clamp(radius*0.02,250m,100000m)). At or above far no focus rays run and off-screen nadir/down branches receive no special refinement. Legacy no-up ordering and scores, fixed leaf and memory budgets, maximum level and complete 2:1-balanced coverage remain unchanged.

src/core/simulation.cpp.local_changes: Optional physical world size is preserved through construction/state/restore, dry landing and geometric gravity/collision/carrier thresholds. Player height1.8m, base walk5.5m/s and original gravity/time periods remain separate metric settings. Legacy state validation/output stays unchanged for default size. Optional explicit flight roll appended to existing look basis; zero-roll defaults and walking horizon semantics retained. An explicit constructor body scope limits selection, gravity, collision and automatic carrier changes to the admitted Planet body; the unrestricted Universe constructor remains unchanged.

include/epoch/planet/simulation.hpp.local_changes: Optional WorldConfig constructor and session field preserve the physical world across restore; default member values retain the original world. Optional explicit flight roll appended to existing look basis; zero-roll defaults and walking horizon semantics retained. An optional immutable body-scope constructor argument restricts the existing simulation for selected Planet projects without replacing its tick or world algorithms.

boundary: One retained upstream ABI/algorithm owner with adapted camera-priority and optional physical-size contracts. Facades are not a completed implementation-module conversion. Original application, renderer, platform loops and worker pool remain excluded. Engine host owns scheduling, memory admission, package approval and camera/render mapping. Default producer mesh/JSON/cache/stream and exploration-session versions remain unchanged; custom size uses typed versioned receipts and immutable cache identity.
